# average frequency

```{r choose the data you wanna use calculate frequency}
df_main_clean <- df_main
df_main_clean <- df_main_clean %>% filter(question %in% c(all_qs))%>%
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = c(all_qs)))

df_main_clean <- df_main_clean %>% group_by(prolific_id,question,block)  %>%
  summarise(resp_freq = mean(response), .groups = "drop")

```


```{r get spont data}
df_main_spont <- df_main_clean %>% filter(block %in% spontaneous)
#average 2 spontaneous blocks
df_main_spont <- df_main_spont %>% group_by(prolific_id,question)  %>%
  summarise(resp_freq = round(mean(resp_freq),1), .groups = "drop")
# df_main_spont <- df_main_spont %>% group_by(prolific_id,question)  %>%
#   summarise(resp_freq = mean(resp_freq), .groups = "drop")

avg_freq <- df_main_spont %>%
  group_by(question) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_resp = mean(resp_freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_resp = sd(resp_freq, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
avg_freq

# test if all category is greater than 0.05 (or 0.5) frequency using wilxcon test
df_wilcox <- df_main_spont %>%
  group_by(question) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(wilcox.test(resp_freq, mu = 0.5, alternative = "greater",correct = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    W = sapply(test, function(x) x$statistic),
    p_value = sapply(test, function(x) x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test)
df_wilcox <- df_wilcox %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")
  ) %>% mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < .001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < .01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < .05  ~ "*",
      TRUE         ~ "ns"
    )
  )
df_wilcox
```

```{r between modality comparison}
df_wide <- df_main_spont %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = question,
    values_from = resp_freq
  )

pairs_first <- combn(first_qs, 2, simplify = FALSE)
pairs_word <- combn(img_word, 2, simplify = FALSE)

run_pairwise <- function(df, pairs, label) {
  map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
    x <- df[[p[1]]]
    y <- df[[p[2]]]
    keep <- complete.cases(x, y)
    d <- x[keep] - y[keep]
    d <- d[d != 0]                          # drop zeros
    test <- wilcox.test(d, mu = 0,
                        paired = FALSE,
                        correct = FALSE,
                        exact = FALSE)
    tibble(
      group = label,
      var1 = p[1], var2 = p[2],
      n = length(d),
      V = test$statistic,
      p = test$p.value
    )
  })
}

res_first <- run_pairwise(df_wide, pairs_first, "General")
res_word  <- run_pairwise(df_wide, pairs_word,  "Forms of Language")

results <- bind_rows(res_first, res_word)

results <- results %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r adding stack bars}
df_main_spont <- df_main_spont %>%

  ungroup()
df_percent
```

# Inner lanugage ability

```{r inner langauge ability}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggbreak)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# --- Data prep ---
question <- "img_lang"
blks <- c("spontaneous", "general", "specific")

dat_hist <- df_main %>%
  filter(question == !!question) %>%
  mutate(block_group = str_split_fixed(block, "_", 2)[, 1]) %>%
  filter(block_group %in% blks) %>%
  group_by(prolific_id, block_group) %>%
  summarise(total_yes = sum(response, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(block_group = factor(block_group, levels = blks))

# --- Plot ---
colors <- c("spontaneous" = "lightgray", "general" = "darkgray", "specific" = "gray")

p <- ggplot(dat_hist, aes(x = total_yes, fill = block_group)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = -0.5, color = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), limits = c(-0.5, 10.5)) +
  scale_y_break(
  c(25, 100),
  scales = "free",
  space = 0.5
) +      
  facet_wrap(~block_group,
             labeller = labeller(block_group = tools::toTitleCase)) +
  labs(
    x = 'Number of "Yes" Responses for Language Question (out of 10)',
    y = "Number of Participants\n(out of 228)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.text.x.top = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank(),
  axis.line.x.top = element_blank()
)

svglite(paste0("./Figures_CogSci_042026/", study,"_", "inner_lang_ability.svg"), width =8, height = 5)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

```{r correlation between Spontaneous and Specific}

df_joined <- df_main_spont %>%
  rename(resp_spont = resp_freq) %>%
  inner_join(
    df_main_spec %>% rename(resp_spec = resp_freq),
    by = c("prolific_id", "question")
  )

df_corr <- df_joined %>%
  group_by(question) %>%
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(resp_spont, resp_spec, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = sapply(test, function(x) x$estimate),
    p   = sapply(test, function(x) x$p.value),
    n   = sapply(test, function(x) x$parameter + 2)  # Spearman uses n-2 internally
  ) %>%
  select(question, rho, p, n)

df_corr <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_corr <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )
```

# Correlation 

```{r correlation between Qs}

block_groups <- list(
  spontaneous = spontaneous,
  specific = c("specific_inner_hearing","specific_inner_speaking")
)

# generic function to average across blocks
prepare_df <- function(df,blocks){
  df %>% filter(block %in% blocks) %>%
  group_by(prolific_id, question) %>%
    summarise(resp_freq = mean(resp_freq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}


for (group in c("spontaneous")) {
df <- prepare_df(df_main_clean, block_groups[[group]])
df_wide <- df %>% 
  select(prolific_id, question, resp_freq) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = question,
              values_from = resp_freq) 

mat <- df_wide %>% select(-prolific_id)

res <- rcorr(as.matrix(mat), type = "spearman")  # recommend Spearman
cor_mat <- res$r
p_mat   <- res$P

upper_idx <- upper.tri(p_mat)
p_vals <- p_mat[upper_idx]
p_adj_vals <- p.adjust(p_vals, method = "fdr")
p_mat_adj <- p_mat
p_mat_adj[upper_idx] <- p_adj_vals
p_mat_adj[lower.tri(p_mat_adj)] <- t(p_mat_adj)[lower.tri(p_mat_adj)]

sig_mat <- matrix("n.s.", nrow = nrow(p_mat_adj), ncol = ncol(p_mat_adj))

sig_mat[p_mat_adj < 0.05]  <- "*"
sig_mat[p_mat_adj < 0.01]  <- "**"
sig_mat[p_mat_adj < 0.001] <- "***"
diag(sig_mat) <- "" 

label_mat <- matrix(
  paste0(round(cor_mat, 2), "\n", sig_mat),
  nrow = nrow(cor_mat)
)

cor_mat[lower.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA
label_mat[lower.tri(label_mat)] <- ""
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)

# cor_df <- melt(cor_mat, na.rm = FALSE)
# label_df <- melt(label_mat)
# 
# cor_df$label <- label_df$value

cor_df <- reshape2::melt(cor_mat, na.rm = FALSE)
label_df <- reshape2::melt(label_mat)

cor_df$label <- label_df$value

# Remove NA values entirely
cor_df <- cor_df[!is.na(cor_df$value), ]

plot<-ggplot(cor_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "#E0E0E0",
    high = "#C4001A",
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cor_df$Var2))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,size =10),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

svglite(paste0("./Figures_CogSci_042026/", study,"_", group, "_Correlation_main_qs.svg"), width =7, height = 5)
print(plot)
dev.off()

}
```

```{r separate for language use and forms of language}
# currently not using this 
make_corr_plot <- function(df, questions_subset, title_text) {
  
  # Subset
  # df_subset <- df %>%
  #   select(prolific_id, question, resp_freq) %>%
  #   filter(question %in% questions_subset) %>%
  #   pivot_wider(names_from = question,
  #               values_from = resp_freq)
  df_subset <- df %>%
  select(prolific_id, question, resp_freq) %>%
  filter(question %in% questions_subset) %>%
  mutate(question = factor(question, levels = questions_subset)) %>%  # 👈 ADD THIS
  pivot_wider(names_from = question,
              values_from = resp_freq)
  
  mat <- df_subset %>% select(-prolific_id)
  
  # Spearman correlation
  res <- rcorr(as.matrix(mat), type = "spearman")
  cor_mat <- res$r
  p_mat   <- res$P
  
  # -------- FDR within subset --------
  upper_idx <- upper.tri(p_mat)
  p_vals <- p_mat[upper_idx]
  p_adj_vals <- p.adjust(p_vals, method = "fdr")
  
  p_mat_adj <- p_mat
  p_mat_adj[upper_idx] <- p_adj_vals
  p_mat_adj[lower.tri(p_mat_adj)] <- 
    t(p_mat_adj)[lower.tri(p_mat_adj)]
  
  # -------- Significance labels --------
  sig_mat <- matrix("n.s.", nrow = nrow(p_mat_adj), 
                    ncol = ncol(p_mat_adj))
  
  sig_mat[p_mat_adj < 0.05]  <- "*"
  sig_mat[p_mat_adj < 0.01]  <- "**"
  sig_mat[p_mat_adj < 0.001] <- "***"
  
  diag(sig_mat) <- ""
  
  label_mat <- matrix(
    paste0(round(cor_mat, 2), "\n", sig_mat),
    nrow = nrow(cor_mat)
  )
  
  # Upper triangle only
  cor_mat[lower.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA
  label_mat[lower.tri(label_mat)] <- ""
  
  # Melt
  cor_df <- melt(cor_mat, na.rm = FALSE)
  label_df <- melt(label_mat)
  cor_df$label <- label_df$value
  cor_df <- cor_df[!is.na(cor_df$value), ]
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3B4CC0",
      mid = "#ECECEC",
      high = "#C4001A",
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      name = "Spearman's ρ"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cor_df$Var2))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      panel.border = element_blank()
    ) +
    ggtitle(title_text)
  
  return(p)
}

block_groups <- list(
  spontaneous = spontaneous,
  specific = c("specific_inner_hearing","specific_inner_speaking")
)

# generic function to average across blocks
prepare_df <- function(df,blocks){
  df %>% filter(block %in% blocks) %>%
  group_by(prolific_id, question) %>%
    summarise(resp_freq = mean(resp_freq, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

df_spont <- prepare_df(df_main_clean, block_groups$spontaneous)
df_specific <- prepare_df(df_main_clean, block_groups$specific)

make_combined <- function(df, group_label){
  p1 <- make_corr_plot(df, first_qs,

  p2 <- make_corr_plot(df, img_word,

}

          width = 6, height = 5)
  print(plot_obj)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r stats}
# choose group
df_main_freq_new <- df_main_freq_new #%>% filter(aud_group == "low")

##  original code
pairs_list <- list(
  c("specific_inner_speaking", "general_inner_speaking"),
  c("general_inner_speaking", "spontaneous"),
  c("specific_inner_hearing",  "general_inner_hearing"),
  c("general_inner_hearing",   "spontaneous"),
  c("general_inner_hearing",   "general_inner_speaking"),
  c("specific_inner_speaking", "specific_inner_hearing")
)


run_tests_one_question <- function(df, question_name) {
  
  df_q <- df %>%
    filter(question == question_name) %>%
    mutate(block = as.character(block)) %>%
    select(prolific_id, block, resp_freq) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = block,
                values_from = resp_freq)

  results <- lapply(pairs_list, function(p) {

    b1 <- p[1]
    b2 <- p[2]

    if (!(b1 %in% colnames(df_q) & b2 %in% colnames(df_q))) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    tmp <- df_q %>%
      select(prolific_id, all_of(b1), all_of(b2)) %>%
      filter(complete.cases(.))
    
    d <- tmp[[b1]] - tmp[[b2]]
    d <- d[d != 0]
    test <- wilcox.test(
      d,
      mu = 0,
      paired = FALSE,
      alternative = "two.sided",
      correct = FALSE,
      exact = FALSE
    )    
    
    # test <- wilcox.test(
    #   tmp[[b1]],
    #   tmp[[b2]],
    #   paired = TRUE,
    #   alternative = "two.sided",
    #   correct = FALSE,
    #   exact = FALSE
    # )

    data.frame(
      question = question_name,
      block1 = b1,
      block2 = b2,
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  })

  bind_rows(results)
}

q_test <- c(first_qs,img_word)
all_tests <- lapply(q_test,
                    function(q) run_tests_one_question(df_main_freq_new, q))
# all_tests <- lapply(unique(df_main_freq_new$question),
#                     function(q) run_tests_one_question(df_main_freq_new, q))

test_results <- bind_rows(all_tests)

test_results <- test_results %>%
  mutate(
    q_group = case_when(
      question %in% first_qs ~ "first_qs",
      question %in% img_word ~ "img_word",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

test_results <- test_results %>%
  group_by(q_group) %>%   # group-level correction
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# test_results <- test_results %>%
#   mutate(
#     p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")
#   ) %>%

test_results <- test_results %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )
```

```{r plot with stats}

library(ggsignif)

# Step 1: offset lookup table
df_main_freq_new <- df_main_freq_new %>%
  mutate(
    question = factor(question),
    block    = factor(block)
  ) #%>% filter(question %in% q_test)
question_levels <- levels(df_main_freq_new$question)
block_levels    <- levels(df_main_freq_new$block)
n_blocks        <- length(block_levels)
dodge_width     <- 0.8

dodge_offsets <- seq(
  -dodge_width / 2 + dodge_width / (2 * n_blocks),
   dodge_width / 2 - dodge_width / (2 * n_blocks),
  length.out = n_blocks
)

offset_df <- tibble(
  block  = block_levels,
  offset = dodge_offsets
)

# Step 2: build annotation_df with correct x positions
# Compute the max bar height (mean + SE) per question as the baseline
bar_tops <- df_main_freq_new %>%
  group_by(question, block) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(resp_freq, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val   = sd(resp_freq, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    top      = mean_val + se_val,
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(question) %>%
  summarise(bar_top = max(top, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(question = as.character(question))

annotation_df <- test_results %>%
  #filter(sig != "n.s.") %>%
  mutate(
    question = factor(question, levels = question_levels),
    q_idx    = as.numeric(question),
    block1   = as.character(block1),
    block2   = as.character(block2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(offset_df, by = c("block1" = "block")) %>%
  rename(offset1 = offset) %>%
  left_join(offset_df, by = c("block2" = "block")) %>%
  rename(offset2 = offset) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = q_idx + pmin(offset1, offset2),
    xmax = q_idx + pmax(offset1, offset2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(bar_tops, by = c("question" = "question")) %>%  # attach bar top per question
  group_by(question) %>%
  arrange(xmax - xmin, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(y_position = bar_top + 0.05 + (row_number() - 1) * 0.07) %>%  # start just above bar
  ungroup()

annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
  mutate(
    panel = case_when(
      question %in% first_qs ~ "General",
      question %in% img_word ~ "Forms of Language",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(panel))

annotation_df <- annotation_df %>% mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c("General","Forms of Language")))

df_main_freq_new <- df_main_freq_new %>%
  mutate(
    panel = case_when(
      question %in% first_qs ~ "General",
      question %in% img_word    ~ "Forms of Language"
    )
  ) %>% mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = c("General","Forms of Language")))

# Step 3: plot
plot <- ggplot(df_main_freq_new,
               aes(x = as.numeric(factor(question, levels = question_levels)),
                   y = resp_freq, fill = block)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean",
           position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), width = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(stat = "summary", fun.data = mean_se,
                position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), width = 0.2) +
  # horizontal line
  geom_segment(
    data = annotation_df,
    aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # significance label at midpoint
  geom_text(
  data = annotation_df,
  aes(
    x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
    y = y_position + 0.01 + ifelse(sig == "ns", 0.03, 0),  # 
    label = sig
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 4
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(question_levels),
    labels = question_levels
  ) + facet_wrap(~ panel,scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.55), breaks = seq(0, 1.2, 0.2)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = BLOCK_COLORS_avg_Spont) +
  labs(x = "Question", y = "Mean response frequency", fill = "Block")

svglite(paste0("./Figures_CogSci_042026/", study,"_", group, "_block_effect.svg"), width =10, height = 5)
print(plot)
dev.off()
```

```{r psiq and main Q}
block_to_use <- spontaneous
save_name <- "spont"
qs_psiq <- c("psiq_vision","psiq_sound","psiq_smell","psiq_taste","psiq_touch","psiq_kinesthetic","psiq_emotional")


df_main_freq <- df_main %>% filter(block %in% block_to_use) %>% filter(question %in% all_qs)
df_main_freq <- df_main_freq %>% group_by(prolific_id,question)  %>%
  summarise(resp_freq_main = mean(response), .groups = "drop") 

df_main_freq_w <- df_main_freq %>% pivot_wider(
  names_from = question,
  values_from = resp_freq_main
)

#df_psiq <- df_psiq %>% mutate(question = factor(question, levels = rev(qs_psiq)))
df_psiq_w <- df_psiq %>% pivot_wider(
  names_from = question,
  values_from = response
) %>% select(-experiment)

df_merged <- df_main_freq_w %>%
  inner_join(df_psiq_w, by = "prolific_id")

vars_main <- df_merged %>%
  select(matches("^(img_)")) %>%
  colnames()

vars_psiq <- df_merged %>%
  select(starts_with("psiq_")) %>%
  colnames()

mat_main  <- as.matrix(df_merged[, vars_main])
mat_psiq  <- as.matrix(df_merged[, vars_psiq])

# rcorr requires one matrix, so bind columns
res <- rcorr(cbind(mat_main, mat_psiq), type = "spearman")

cor_mat <- res$r
p_mat   <- res$P

cor_cross <- cor_mat[vars_main, vars_psiq]
p_cross   <- p_mat[vars_main, vars_psiq]

p_adj <- matrix(
  p.adjust(as.vector(p_cross), method = "fdr"),
  nrow = nrow(p_cross),
  dimnames = dimnames(p_cross)
)


sig_mat <- matrix("",
                  nrow = nrow(p_adj),
                  ncol = ncol(p_adj),
                  dimnames = dimnames(p_adj))

sig_mat[p_adj < 0.05]  <- "*"
sig_mat[p_adj < 0.01]  <- "**"
sig_mat[p_adj < 0.001] <- "***"

label_mat <- matrix(
  paste0(round(cor_cross, 2), "\n", sig_mat),
  nrow = nrow(cor_cross),
  dimnames = dimnames(cor_cross)
)

cor_df   <- reshape2::melt(cor_cross)
label_df <- reshape2::melt(label_mat)

colnames(cor_df)   <- c("img_var", "psiq_var", "rho")
colnames(label_df) <- c("img_var", "psiq_var", "label")

plot_df <- merge(cor_df, label_df,
                 by = c("img_var", "psiq_var"))
plot_df$psiq_var <- factor(plot_df$psiq_var, levels = qs_psiq)
plot_df$img_var <- factor(plot_df$img_var, levels = rev(all_qs))

plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = img_var, x = psiq_var, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "#E0E0E0",
    high = "#C4001A",
    limits = c(-0.3, 0.3),
    name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

plot
ggsave(paste0('./Figures_CogSci_042026/', save_name, '_Psiq2main.png'), width=13, height=13, units="cm")
```
